character: Linked ski area above Flims, Laax and Falera in Graubünden, reaching the Vorab glacier at 3,018 m. LAAX is known for its freestyle focus, with large snow parks and a halfpipe that hosts the LAAX Open.
learning: Reference note: ski schools operate in Laax and Flims. Confirm beginner areas and lesson products.
